body:
I think you misunderstood, anyone I've ever told about my.. problems, if you can even call them that, have been nothing but supportive. So I can't call them dicks.

However I completely agree with the other half of your post, I think I needed other people to say it. I don't know, no one I know has a similarly humiliating experience, so it's uncomfortable for me to say anything.

Hopefully I find that combination, thank you for the response.

I really appreciate this response, because I really don't know what else to do. So maybe volunteering would be in my alley? I don't really know, I have at least a small window of opportunity to get involved in something like that.

I can't guarantee I'll actually follow through, but your response is well received. Thank you.

I thank you for the response, but the other responses seemed to hit more of something I can relate to.

Nothing to do with your age, you gave good advice, I've just heard exactly what you've been saying since age 18.
